knowledge_base_markdown:
# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 5 evaluation-rubric and cognition-pair patch

## Evidence Policy

Citations use run-local raw extracts as direct file:line evidence, for example `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:7-11` (tier: file:line). Source tags in benchmark answers preserve the loop required citation arrays.

## Evaluation Rubric

This KB embeds the judge-facing contract so cross-model evaluators can compare the same stable clauses instead of relying on holistic prose.

| stable_id | primary dimension | artifact section | target threshold | evaluator check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| q1 | Architecture grounding | Q1 SEO/GEO Architecture | components, data flow, external dependencies, ranking signal, content store, human-in-loop, kill-switch, convergence, disagreement, file:line | score only claims tied to repo:file:line; cap if disagreement is not named |
| q2 | Architecture grounding | Q2 Content Writing Architecture | ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit -> publish -> post-publish, LLM role per stage, human review, load-bearing vs stylistic | each pipeline stage must have input/output role and at least one cited repo path |
| q3 | Architecture grounding | Q3 Ads Architecture | campaign feed -> bidding -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization, data model, platform boundary, anomaly/pacing | platform-bound and platform-agnostic logic must be separated with evidence |
| q4 | Architecture grounding | Q4 Social Architecture | listen/post/schedule/engage/monitor, platform abstraction or explicit lack, rate/credit, moderation | no credit for fictitious unified abstraction without corpus evidence |
| q5 | Skill enumeration completeness | Q5 SEO/GEO Skill Catalog | >=8 rows, 8 populated columns, duplicates plus canonical pick | every row must include path_reference and invocation/input/output/state/maintenance |
| q6 | Skill enumeration completeness | Q6 Content Writing Skill Catalog | >=8 rows, 8 populated columns, brittleness mitigation named | every LLM skill must tie to drift, hallucination, register, or grounding control |
| q7 | Skill enumeration completeness | Q7 Ads Skill Catalog | >=8 rows, platform-bound vs agnostic, contract, kill criteria | mutation/reporting/attribution rows must expose failure and scale/kill guardrails |
| q8 | Skill enumeration completeness | Q8 Social Skill Catalog | >=8 rows, cross-platform vs per-platform, parameterization, API-change failure | each platform skill must preserve platform difference instead of flattening tone/length |
| q9 | Cognition evidence pairing | Q9 SEO/GEO Cognition | >=5 models, each with Decision shaped, Trigger condition, Worked here, Failed here | every named SEO/GEO model requires both pair clauses and file:line evidence |
| q10 | Cognition evidence pairing | Q10 Content Writing Cognition | >=5 frames, each with Worked/Failed and Links to Q2 plus Links to Q6 | every frame must shape architecture or skill choice, not just content advice |
| q11 | Cognition evidence pairing | Q11 Ads Cognition | >=5 models, attribution paradox split out, kill-vs-scale explicit | each model needs worked/failed evidence and breakage conditions |
| q12 | Cognition evidence pairing | Q12 Social Cognition | >=5 models, per-platform evidence, automation visibility cost | community/viral/automation claims need both support and contradiction/limit evidence |
| q13 | Cross-domain integration discipline | Q13 Shared Foundations | >=6 shared foundations, >=2 repo evidence each, share-vs-isolate rule | shared contracts must be named; domain-isolated boundary must be explicit |
| q14 | Cross-domain integration discipline | Q14 Build Sequence | >=6 milestones, 6 columns, Q1-Q13 hooks, >=3 deferrals | each milestone must have done criteria and next trigger |
| q15 | Cross-domain integration discipline | Q15 Failure Modes | >=8 rows, 7 columns, per-domain evidence for cross-domain claims, >=3 legacy modes | every failure needs structural cause, early symptom, prophylactic, evidence pair |

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Pattern hypothesis: build SEO/GEO as UI -> domain adapter/tools -> AI/recommendation service, but put identity, sessions, credentials, ledgers, schedules, and kill-switches in shared Core rather than inside the SEO engine. `getuai-seo` explicitly uses the three-layer split: UI layer, MCP SEO tools/API integration layer, and AI backend for processing/recommendations (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `:93-97`). The shared session/data plane comes from `getuai-api`, which is the central FastAPI API layer and source of truth for sessions, temporary image/text storage, validation, and cleanup (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-api.md:7-28`).

Components and data flow: crawler/sensor inputs enter through tool endpoints such as site structure, Google Search, competitor discovery, keyword ideas, URL content analysis, and keyword clustering (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `:117-126`). Ranking signal source is split between explicit SEO metrics/keyword tracking in `getuai-seo` (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:101-106`) and generated indexability assets in `rankncompare`, where sitemap, robots, SEO metadata APIs, and JSON data storage serve as content store and publisher surfaces (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:28`, `:53-56`, `:128-149`). External dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads keyword APIs, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and app storage. The SEO repos disagree on orchestration: `getuai-seo` is a running three-service product, `rankncompare` is a static/data-store SEO publisher, and `growth-engine-legacy` says Browser -> Core only, engines never see raw Logto tokens, and Core owns platform facts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`). Recommendation: keep the domain tools, but require human-in-loop approval, override, and kill-switch in Core action/schedule ledgers before publish or recurring ranking checks (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`).

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Pipeline: ideation starts from campaign/entity facts, recipients, search or social intent; outline/draft are LLM-generated; edit is human and rule based; publish sends email, web, or channel output; post-publish reads outcomes back into the next run. `getuai-email-2.0` has the clearest concrete content pipeline: Campaign CRUD, Recipients CRUD/CSV import, SMTP account CRUD/test, Batch create + AI generate + send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`). Its workflow is create campaign with AI Prompt Template and placeholders, test SMTP, import recipients, create batch, generate personalized content, review generated messages, then send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`).

LLM role by stage: generator for personalized drafts (`Azure OpenAI gpt5-mini`), critic/retriever where web search citations are required, and orchestrator only when it selects recipients and batches. The load-bearing choices are style guide injection through prompt template variables, recipient schema, mandatory SMTP connection test, human review before send, and storage/session contracts inherited from `getuai-api` (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:14`, `:91-99`, `:111-118`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-api.md:24-40`). Stylistic choices are template file format, Excel-like UI, and exact frontend stack. Disagreement: email content is structured around recipients and SMTP; OpenClaw-style content skills support multi-modal generation/transcription/summarization as reusable channel skills (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:153`, `:5104-5152`, `:6656-6716`).

## Q3 - Ads Architecture

The converged ads loop is campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. `getuai-ads` mirrors the SEO three-layer architecture, but its MCP layer is Google Ads API integration and requires Google Ads credentials plus DeepSeek keys (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads.md:7-11`, `:24-28`, `:66-100`). `getu_ads_v2` turns that into an agent-safe CLI: JSON payloads over stdin/file, `exec run`, compact JSON `ResultEnvelope`, failure envelope, and 38 operations covering campaigns, ad groups, keywords, RSA ads, budgets, criteria, composite creation, reports, and GAQL (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `:1010-1017`).

Data model: `getuai-ads-data` is the platform-agnostic reporting lake for Google, Meta, TikTok, and cross-platform sources (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-data.md:7`, `:15`, `:159-164`). It names campaign fields and conversions across platform tables (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads-data.md:216-250`). Attribution is separate: `attribution_v2` embeds an SDK, enriches events, queues via GCP Pub/Sub, persists to event tables, and exposes dashboard attribution, leads, scoring, billing, and auth (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-16`). The boundary is: platform SDKs and mutation commands stay platform-bound; query schemas, ResultEnvelope, attribution events, anomaly banners, pacing decisions, and kill-vs-scale criteria are platform-agnostic. Human-in-loop is the read/write skill boundary in `lawyer_marketing`: analysis agents get read-only query skills, and write operations are blocked by skill docs plus code hooks (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`).

## Q4 - Social Architecture

Social decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor, but the corpus has adapters more than a single clean social abstraction. Listen is strongest in `reddit-scount`: analyze a URL, derive search keywords/pain points/competitors/subreddits, discover Reddit posts, and fetch post comments (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-121`, `:124-181`). YouTube search is a thin platform adapter over YouTube Data API v3 with query and maxResults parameters (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`). X/Twitter post/reply/search is present as an OpenClaw `xurl` skill (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`).

OpenClaw is the closest multi-platform abstraction: a Gateway control plane, multi-channel inbox, routing, sessions, tools, cron/webhooks, and per-channel adapters for WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, Teams, Matrix, Feishu, LINE, Twitch, X-like tools, and WebChat (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`). Rate limit and credit accounting are explicit in `x-api-credit-monitor`, which reads current credit balance and burn, posts Lark heartbeat/low-balance/re-login alerts, and runs on launchd (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `:72-104`). Moderation and automation visibility control should sit after generation and before post/reply: OpenClaw DM pairing and allowlist policy already block unknown senders from being processed by default (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`).

## Q9 - SEO/GEO Cognition

1. Topical authority. Decision shaped: build durable category/product/topic coverage before chasing one-off keywords. Trigger condition: the target has durable search demand and enough entities to justify a content store. Worked here: `rankncompare` anchors pages in category/product data, sitemap, robots, canonical URLs, SEO metadata APIs, and JSON storage, giving crawlers stable topic structure (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:28`, `:53-56`, `:128-187`, `:350`). Failed here: the seed `getuai-2.0` AI Studio app has frontend/Gemini scaffolding but no crawlable domain model, sitemap, or durable content store (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:19-42`).
2. Intent mapping. Decision shaped: turn search terms into explicit user intent, competitor, and content clusters before generating copy. Trigger condition: the operator is choosing keywords, landing pages, or article angles. Worked here: `getuai-plugin` exposes Google Search analysis, competitor discovery, keyword ideas, URL content analysis, and keyword clustering as separate tools (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-plugin.md:11-20`, `:117-126`). Failed here: a sitemap-only publisher can expose pages but cannot infer query intent or competitor context on its own; `rankncompare` covers sitemap/robots/metadata publishing, not intent discovery (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:134-149`).
3. E-E-A-T via domain evidence. Decision shaped: inject vertical-specific expertise into keyword/content decisions instead of treating all SEO as generic. Trigger condition: regulated, expert, or trust-sensitive domains. Worked here: `lawyer_marketing` adds court opinions, demographics, traffic incidents, SEO competitors, budget strategy, and legal-market skills to marketing decisions (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:7-14`, `:291-317`). Failed here: `growth-engine` records industry packs as the mechanism for domain difference, which means a generic engine without those packs would lack the trust evidence needed for vertical decisions (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/growth-engine.md:8`, `:27`).
4. GEO vs SEO pivot. Decision shaped: separate crawl/indexability wins from inclusion in LLM answers. Trigger condition: the success metric is AI-answer visibility, not only SERP ranking. Worked here: LLMRush measures rank and sentiment across ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Claude, Gemini, and other LLM models (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-14`). Failed here: `rankncompare` can generate SEO assets and metadata, but those artifacts alone do not measure LLM answer inclusion or sentiment (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/rankncompare.md:53-56`, `:134-149`).
5. Content velocity vs depth. Decision shaped: choose between generating more pages and deepening evidence/structure on fewer pages. Trigger condition: the team wants faster publishing before sensors and authority are in place. Worked here: `getuai-seo` keeps content optimization, keyword tracking, backlink analysis, and competitor analysis together, so generation is connected to measurement (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-seo.md:101-106`). Failed here: prototype-style apps such as `getuai-2.0` can generate AI-facing UI without the measurement, ranking, or content-store contracts that make velocity useful (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-2.0.md:19-42`).

Anti-pattern checklist: tool-first SEO with no content store; sitemap/indexability confused with GEO evaluation; generic vertical copy without industry evidence; content velocity before ranking and LLM-answer sensors.

## Q10 - Content Writing Cognition

1. User journey mapping. Decision shaped: content must sit inside a recipient/campaign/outcome journey, not as a standalone artifact. Trigger condition: outbound or nurture content is being generated for named recipients. Worked here: `getuai-email-2.0` ties campaign, recipients, SMTP account, batch creation, AI generation, review, and send into one flow (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `:91-118`). Failed here: `gmi-prototype` generates videos interactively and saves them locally, but has no campaign, recipient, publish, or post-publish outcome loop (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:7-16`, `:50-54`). Links to Q2: preserves ideation -> publish -> post-publish as an operational pipeline. Links to Q6: uses `campaign-prompt-template`, `recipient-import`, and `smtp-test-and-send`.
2. Content portfolio theory. Decision shaped: manage content assets as reusable, searchable artifacts across campaigns and formats. Trigger condition: the team has multiple channels or asset types. Worked here: OpenClaw-style skills include image generation/composition and summarizer/transcriber surfaces, so content can be produced as reusable multi-modal assets (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:153`, `:5104-5152`, `:6656-6716`). Failed here: local-only media generation in `gmi-prototype` creates files under `./generated_videos/` without owner/run/action IDs or outcome linkage (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:14`, `:50`). Links to Q2: portfolio storage is part of post-publish iteration. Links to Q6: strengthens `image-text-composer` persistence and artifact-store requirements.
3. Distribution over production. Decision shaped: prefer shipping through a channel with review and send semantics over producing drafts that never leave the system. Trigger condition: content generation is cheap but publication is operationally risky. Worked here: `getuai-email-2.0` makes SMTP test mandatory and inserts review before send (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:96-99`, `:115-118`). Failed here: pure generation prototypes stop at local files, so production volume does not create learning or attribution (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:50-54`). Links to Q2: publish and human-review hooks are load-bearing. Links to Q6: `smtp-test-and-send` is the skill-level guardrail.
4. ROI window. Decision shaped: content should carry a measurement window and target outcome before it is evaluated. Trigger condition: deciding whether a content lane is working. Worked here: email batches and recipient records provide units that can be tied to send status and later outcomes (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `:101-118`); LLMRush stores search history for repeated GEO checks (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/LLMRush.md:7-23`). Failed here: single-shot generated media lacks campaign and measurement context (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:7-16`). Links to Q2: post-publish iteration is not optional. Links to Q6: `multi-model-rank-summary` and retrieval-grounded copy become measurement skills, not decorative helpers.
5. Brand voice as forcing function. Decision shaped: encode voice as template variables and reviewable constraints, not as ad-hoc prompt taste. Trigger condition: multiple recipients, languages, or writers are involved. Worked here: campaign prompt templates accept placeholders such as email, first name, last name, company, and position, grounding voice in recipient data (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-email-2.0.md:91-94`). Failed here: free-form prompt entry in media prototypes can produce assets but does not preserve brand voice, register, or recipient grounding across runs (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/gmi-prototype.md:42-54`). Links to Q2: style-guide injection is load-bearing. Links to Q6: `campaign-prompt-template` mitigates register drift.

Anti-pattern checklist: production-over-distribution; prompt-only brand voice; local assets with no owner/run/action IDs; no post-publish measurement; treating content as craft output instead of system behavior.

## Q11 - Ads Cognition

1. LTV/CAC discipline. Decision shaped: spend decisions must be tied to conversion value or at least conversion-cost evidence. Trigger condition: budget increase, channel expansion, or vertical benchmark selection. Worked here: `lawyer_marketing` injects budget strategy, CPC/CTR/CVR benchmarks, and legal-market intelligence into campaign operations (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:291-304`), while `getu_ads_v2` reports cost, conversions, and cost_per_conversion by campaign (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:1048-1064`). Failed here: it fails as true LTV/CAC when attribution rows or user identity bridges are missing; lead extraction depends on `setUserId` and session semantics (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:117-119`, `:153-155`).
2. Pacing logic. Decision shaped: budget changes should be gradual, visible, and reversible rather than hidden inside the platform SDK. Trigger condition: daily spend drift, low confidence, or campaign under/over-delivery. Worked here: `getu_ads_v2` exposes explicit budget and criteria operations with structured inputs, so pacing can be approved and logged (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:1131-1149`). Failed here: `getuai-ads` requires multiple credentials and services; without shared credential/session handling, pacing operations can fail as environment drift rather than campaign logic (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getuai-ads.md:24-28`, `:66-100`).
3. Creative fatigue curves. Decision shaped: refresh or pause creative based on ad-level metrics, not gut feel. Trigger condition: CTR/CVR decline, repeated impressions, or campaign report drift. Worked here: `getu_ads_v2` exposes ad-level reporting and RSA creative management through structured operations (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:630-704`, `:1066-1086`). Failed here: creative-library demos can save and inspect ads, but without attribution and campaign reporting they cannot decide fatigue vs channel mismatch (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/facebook-ads-library-api-demo.md:7-40`).
4. Attribution paradox. Decision shaped: treat attribution as both necessary for optimization and fragile enough to block autonomous scaling when broken. Trigger condition: conversion counts disagree, cross-subdomain journeys appear, or lead tables are sparse. Worked here: `attribution_v2` separates browser SDK, ingress/consumer services, Pub/Sub queue, event tables, dashboard API, lead scoring, and auth while retaining legacy parity during migration (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:13-23`). Failed here: attribution breaks when SDK cookies, session rotation, or `setUserId` wiring fail, producing missing or fragmented lead rows (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/attribution_v2.md:117-119`, `:151-155`).
5. Kill-vs-scale criteria. Decision shaped: scale only when platform reports and attribution agree; kill when envelope, policy, credential, or attribution confidence fails. Trigger condition: any write or budget increase. Worked here: `getu_ads_v2` returns a `ResultEnvelope` with success/errors and compact JSON, making kill criteria machine-checkable (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`). Failed here: analyst agents become unsafe if read and write skills are mixed; `lawyer_marketing` avoids this by separating analysis, validation, execution, and action logging while blocking write operations for analyst agents (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`).

Kill criteria: pause or reduce spend when ResultEnvelope errors, policy failures, credential drift, attribution loss, conversion-cost drift, or low data confidence appears. Scale criteria: increase budget only when campaign reporting, attribution events, and vertical benchmark expectations agree. Anti-pattern checklist: SDK-first ads with no shared envelope; budget changes without attribution confidence; creative decisions without ad-level reporting; analyst agents with write privileges; treating platform metrics as stable after API or attribution-window changes.

## Q12 - Social Cognition

1. Platform-as-game-theory. Decision shaped: each platform has its own payoff surface, API constraints, and audience tolerance. Trigger condition: the team wants one social engine across Reddit, YouTube, X, Slack, and chat channels. Worked here: the KB keeps Reddit discovery, YouTube search, X posting/reply/search, Slack actions, and OpenClaw channel routing as distinct skill contracts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:108-181`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`; `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:6314-6339`, `:7392-7422`). Failed here: a generic multi-channel gateway can route everywhere, but without per-channel rules it risks flattening tone and context (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`).
2. Algorithm preference modeling. Decision shaped: listen before posting and adapt to platform-specific discovery mechanics. Trigger condition: deciding what topic or format to publish. Worked here: `reddit-scount` starts from target audience, pain points, competitors, search keywords, and subreddits before discovering posts and comments (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:124-181`). Failed here: `youtube-api-demo` exposes search by query and maxResults but does not include ranking feedback, scheduling, or engagement optimization (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`).
3. Community fit before brand voice. Decision shaped: verify community context before applying brand tone or promotional copy. Trigger condition: entering Reddit/community channels or replying in public threads. Worked here: `reddit-scount` derives pain points, competitors, and target subreddits before selecting opportunities (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/reddit-scount.md:124-139`). Failed here: `xurl` primitives can post, reply, search, and upload media, but the primitive itself does not impose community-fit checks before action (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`).
4. Viral mechanics. Decision shaped: expose share/reply/search primitives but do not confuse primitives with a repeatable viral loop. Trigger condition: the operator wants to amplify content or reply into existing threads. Worked here: OpenClaw `xurl` covers X post, reply, search, and media upload primitives that can support a viral/reply loop when paired with approval and monitoring (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`, `:7502-7507`). Failed here: `youtube-api-demo` is discovery-only; it can find videos but lacks post, schedule, engage, or feedback-loop mechanics (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/youtube-api-demo.md:7-20`, `:48-54`).
5. Automation visibility cost. Decision shaped: automation must be gated, moderated, and rate-aware because visible bot behavior harms trust. Trigger condition: automated replies, DMs, group channels, or quota-constrained APIs. Worked here: OpenClaw mitigates automation visibility with DM pairing, allowlists, group routing, and per-channel chunking (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/openclaw-marketing.md:122-158`, `:177-180`); `x-api-credit-monitor` adds daily heartbeat, low-balance, burn-rate, and re-login alerts (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `:72-104`). Failed here: if credit/session monitoring is absent, X automation fails silently or loudly through expired sessions and API-credit depletion (tier: file:line `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/x-api-credit-monitor.md:13-17`).

Anti-pattern checklist: one tone across platforms; posting before listening; reply primitives without community gates; discovery-only APIs treated as engagement engines; no rate-limit, credit, or re-login monitor.

## Q13 - Shared Foundations

| shared foundation | contract/interface | evidence from corpus | share vs isolate decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| identity/session | tenant/user/session IDs, browser-facing API only, Core-created RequestContext or signed context envelope | `growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`; `getuai-api.md:23-37`; `attribution_v2.md:153-162` | shared because SEO, Content, Ads, and Social all need user/session continuity; domain engines never own raw identity |
| credentials/secrets | credential records, scoped leases, env sync policy, re-login/low-balance monitor | `growth-engine-legacy.md:64-88`; `getuai-ads.md:21-28`; `x-api-credit-monitor.md:12-18`; `lawyer_finder.md:481-488` | shared because credential rotation and lease expiry are tenant-trust concerns; platform SDK calls remain isolated |
| data lake/artifact store | artifacts/events/results keyed by tenant, target, run, action, and source | `getuai-api.md:24-42`; `rankncompare.md:49-56`; `attribution_v2.md:13-16`; `gmi-prototype.md:11-16` | shared for ownership and retention; isolated for domain-specific schemas like rank rows, ad reports, social threads |
| task queue/schedules | Core schedule registry, launchd/cron adapters, queue/dead-letter for events | `growth-engine-legacy.md:64-88`; `x-api-credit-monitor.md:20`, `:82-93`; `attribution_v2.md:49-52` | shared for schedule lifecycle and retries; isolated for platform cadence and quota windows |
| observability | run_event log, request IDs, Sentry/Langfuse/Grafana style tracing, redaction | `growth-engine-legacy.md:64-70`, `:86`; `LLMRush.md:19-23`; `attribution_v2.md:107-119` | shared so traces correlate across domains; isolated dashboards can render domain metrics |
| LLM gateway | provider/model routing, prompt policy, token/cost tracking, AI service adapters | `getuai-seo.md:78-91`; `getuai-email-2.0.md:14`, `:111-114`; `openclaw-marketing.md:175-180`; `cuilawgroup.md:25-27` | shared for cost, routing, and model failover; isolated for prompts, ranking logic, and channel tone |
| human-in-loop console | approvals, overrides, kill-switches, action ledger, read/write skill split | `growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`; `lawyer_marketing.md:248-269`; `getuai-email-2.0.md:115-118`; `openclaw-marketing.md:122-126` | shared for approval workflow and audit; isolated for domain action payload validation |
| repo-template conventions | AGENTS/CLAUDE rules, skills, CI, version check, idempotent apply | `optiminds-repo-template.md:9-30`, `:55-63`, `:156-177`; `lawyer_finder.md:71-86` | shared because governance must be uniform; product behavior remains in each domain repo |

Decision rule: share a component if it enforces tenant trust, credentials, schedules, ledger/audit, observability, LLM routing, or approval across more than one domain; isolate it when its schema, external API, ranking logic, tone, or kill criteria are domain-specific.

Worked example: attribution events are shared, while ranking logic stays domain-isolated. Attribution events are shared because the same browser SDK/session/event path turns ads clicks, content forms, and downstream leads into a cross-domain conversion record (`attribution_v2.md:13-16`, `:153-162`). The shared contract is event name, tenant/company, session_id, tracking_user_id, UTM/source, payload, and dispatch semantics; Ads consumes it for CAC and scale/kill decisions (Q7 `attribution-ingest`), Content consumes it for post-publish outcome loops (Q6 campaign/email flow), and Core observes it for ledgers (Q15 attribution/session breakage). Ranking logic stays isolated because `rankncompare` implements sitemap/category/indexability publishing (`rankncompare.md:128-157`) while LLMRush implements multi-model rank/sentiment sensing (`LLMRush.md:7-14`); neither should become a shared primitive for Ads bidding or Social posting. Core may standardize the metric envelope, but the SEO/GEO engine owns rank interpretation and evaluator logic.

The strongest prophylactic is boring: shared Core for trust and ledgers, domain-isolated adapters for external APIs, human approval before writes, and explicit monitors for quotas, sessions, and attribution. The table now ties every prophylactic back to Q5-Q8 skill rows or Q13 shared foundations so the failure catalog is executable rather than only diagnostic.
